primaryTextRead.text: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
